messages:
amelia: Quick heads-up — planning v2 switchboard rollout in eu-west at 02:00 UTC tonight. Need prober pinlist + mobile client impact sign-off. Who's on call?
raj: i'm on call. can you post deploybot window and which tenants?
nameilia: rolling to: eu/* (no prod-legacy tenants), window 02:00-03:00. Can we pin prober-only traffic to v1 for 30m if prober fails?
patrick: +1 for pin fallback. mobile sdk 1.4.2 has compat sniff we should pin for 1h.
ops-jen: noted. prep runbooks updated. release-notes PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/421
deploy-bot: /schedule rollout v2 --region eu-west --window 2025-04-01T02:00Z/2025-04-01T03:00Z --canary 5% --probe prober-switch
deploy-bot: scheduled job id 8821 by amelia — canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m
sre-liz: setting alert thresholds: canary error >1.5% OR latency p95 >1200ms triggers pause + auto-pin
marco: added client-prober test that hits v2 header negotiation, pushed to smoke: ci/infra#213
raj: confirm telemetry hooks enabled? need per-tenant token breakdown
sre-liz: yes, token-level tracing is on for the roll (sampling 100%)
ops-jen: runbook excerpt: if canary errors spike, run `deploy-bot rollback 8821` and pin header route for affected tenants: `api.pin header=Client-Version v1` 
patrick: can someone add mobile-team to the thread? @mobile-team please review SDK pin
mobile-team: thanks — 1.4.2 OK to pin for 1h. we'll watch crashlytics during window.
deploy-bot: canary progress: 5% -> 25% (10m) -> 40% (15m) — metrics nominal
sre-liz: seeing small spike in 1 tenant (tenant-id: t-342). requesting probe log snippet
raj: grabbing logs now:
```
2025-04-01T02:18:12Z GET /v2 -> 500 {tenant: t-342} upstream: kv-cache-miss
2025-04-01T02:18:13Z GET /v2 -> 500 {tenant: t-342} upstream: model-timeout
```
sre-liz: hm, spike correlates with model-timeout on that shard. recommend pin tenant t-342 back to v1 and pause further ramp.
amelia: do it — ops-jen can you run the pin and pause?
ops-jen: running: `deploy-bot pin tenant t-342 --target v1 --reason "canary model-timeout" --ttl 1h`
deploy-bot: tenant t-342 pinned to v1 (ttl 1h). Pausing roll for investigation. job 8821 status: PAUSED
patrick: thanks. will notify support and add to release notes: "t-342 observed transient timeouts; tenant pinned to v1 while we investigate."
sre-liz: creating postmortem stub and assigning to runtime-team. assigning alert to @raj
raj: on it — collecting kernel/hw metrics now. I'll update in #eng-runtime
amelia: good catch everyone. we'll reconvene at 02:45 UTC to decide resume vs rollback. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled follow-up check at 2025-04-01T02:45Z
